about.heading: Hi, I'm Lennard
about.intro: Fullstack developer now directly helping SME owners with IT challenges
about.bio:
After spending over 5 years building software at companies like SDB Group and Four Digits, I decided to focus my energy on helping business owners directly. I realized that many SMEs don't need a full-time developer, but someone who understands both technology and their business operations.

Many businesses let IT problems pile up, offload them to the office manager, or pay top dollar at expensive agencies. Techvast fills that gap: one expert point of contact for everything digital. Alongside my technical background, I also have experience in theater and group facilitation, allowing me to explain complex matters clearly without the jargon.
